verdict.rationale: The OCR processor can return a per-page blocks array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, block labels and extracted content, plus page/block/word confidence scores. Users could build page + bbox + snippet citations from those blocks. However, the structured-extraction path (document_annotation into a user-defined JSON schema) returns document-level annotations, with no documented per-field link back to page, box or source span. An early community tester also reported no text bounding boxes, though that likely predates include_blocks. Missing for 10: per-field provenance on structured extraction outputs (page, bbox, source snippet attached to each extracted field), word/span-level grounding of extracted values, and hands-on corroboration that block bboxes are reliable.
